text: BusyBox sed rejected the multi-line append. Use two single-line appends instead, label first so time ends up directly after .radar-clock.
command: cd /work/apps/canvas/src/ops && sed -i '70a .radar-clock-label { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 1.5px; color: var(--radar-dim); }' radar.css && sed -i '70a .radar-clock-time { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1px; color: var(--radar-ink); }' radar.css && sed -n '69,74p' radar.css
